853294.name: SMT1
853294.summary: Located in mitochondrion. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853300.name: YAK1
853300.summary: Enables protein serine/threonine kinase activity and protein tyrosine kinase activity. Involved in cAMP/PKA signal transduction; positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription; and positive regulation of cell-substrate adhesion. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Orthologous to human HIPK4 (homeodomain interacting protein kinase 4). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853302.name: YUR1
853302.summary: Enables mannosyltransferase activity. Involved in cell wall mannoprotein biosynthetic process and protein N-linked glycosylation. Located in Golgi apparatus. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853303.name: TIF2
853303.summary: Enables RNA helicase activity and translation initiation factor activity. Involved in positive regulation of formation of translation preinitiation complex and translational initiation. Located in cytoplasmic stress granule and plasma membrane. Part of eukaryotic translation initiation factor 4F complex. Is active in cytoplasm. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in neurodevelopmental disorder with hypotonia and speech delay. Orthologous to human EIF4A1 (eukaryotic translation initiation factor 4A1) and EIF4A2 (eukaryotic translation initiation factor 4A2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853305.name: RPS21B
853305.summary: A structural constituent of ribosome. Involved in endonucleolytic cleavage in ITS1 to separate SSU-rRNA from 5.8S rRNA and LSU-rRNA from tricistronic rRNA transcript (SSU-rRNA, 5.8S rRNA, LSU-rRNA) and endonucleolytic cleavage to generate mature 3'-end of SSU-rRNA from (SSU-rRNA, 5.8S rRNA, LSU-rRNA). Part of cytosolic small ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to human RPS21 (ribosomal protein S21). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853307.name: LCB3
853307.summary: Enables sphingosine-1-phosphate phosphatase activity. Involved in calcium-mediated signaling. Located in endoplasmic reticulum. Orthologous to several human genes including SGPP1 (sphingosine-1-phosphate phosphatase 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853315.name: SPT10
853315.summary: Enables promoter-specific chromatin binding activity and sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Involved in several processes, including heterochromatin formation; negative regulation of autophagy; and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Located in nucleus. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853319.name: MTC1
853319.summary: Located in mitochondrion. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853327.name: ASF1
853327.summary: Enables acetyltransferase activator activity and histone binding activity. Involved in several processes, including DNA replication-dependent chromatin assembly; constitutive heterochromatin formation; and nucleosome disassembly. Located in cytosol and nucleus. Part of H3 histone acetyltransferase complex. Orthologous to several human genes including ASF1A (anti-silencing function 1A histone chaperone). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853345.name: LSB6
853345.summary: Enables 1-phosphatidylinositol 4-kinase activity. Involved in phosphatidylinositol phosphate biosynthetic process. Located in fungal-type vacuole membrane and plasma membrane. Orthologous to human PI4K2A (phosphatidylinositol 4-kinase type 2 alpha) and PI4K2B (phosphatidylinositol 4-kinase type 2 beta). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853349.name: MRPL49
853349.summary: A structural constituent of ribosome. Predicted to be involved in mitochondrial translation. Located in mitochondrion. Part of mitochondrial large ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to human MRPL21 (mitochondrial ribosomal protein L21). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853350.name: BCK1
853350.description: mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase kinase BCK1
853350.otherdesignations: mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase kinase BCK1
853350.nomenclaturename: mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase kinase BCK1
853350.summary: Enables MAP kinase kinase kinase activity. Involved in several processes, including intracellular signal transduction; pexophagy; and regulation of fungal-type cell wall organization. Located in cellular bud neck; cytoplasm; and mating projection tip. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in clear cell renal cell carcinoma; immunodeficiency 112; lung cancer; and stomach cancer. Orthologous to human MAP3K14 (mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase kinase 14) and MAP3K8 (mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase kinase 8). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853353.name: SRS2
853353.summary: Enables 3'-5' DNA helicase activity and enzyme activator activity. Involved in several processes, including DNA metabolic process; DNA recombinase disassembly; and negative regulation of double-strand break repair via homologous recombination. Located in nucleus. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853365.name: SCP160
853365.summary: Enables G-protein alpha-subunit binding activity and mRNA binding activity. Involved in several processes, including chemotropism; constitutive heterochromatin formation; and pheromone-dependent signal transduction involved in conjugation with cellular fusion. Located in endoplasmic reticulum membrane. Orthologous to human HDLBP (high density lipoprotein binding protein). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853366.name: PRY1
853366.summary: Enables fatty acid binding activity; magnesium ion binding activity; and sterol binding activity. Involved in fatty acid transport and sterol transport. Located in extracellular region. Orthologous to human GLIPR2 (GLI pathogenesis related 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853374.name: ARG2
853374.summary: Enables L-glutamate N-acetyltransferase activity, acting on acetyl-CoA as donor. Involved in L-arginine biosynthetic process and ornithine biosynthetic process. Located in mitochondrial matrix. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in N-acetylglutamate synthase deficiency and amino acid metabolic disorder. Orthologous to human NAGS (N-acetylglutamate synthase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853381.name: DLS1
853381.summary: Predicted to enable protein heterodimerization activity. Involved in subtelomeric heterochromatin formation. Acts upstream of or within regulation of DNA double-strand break processing. Located in nucleus. Part of CHRAC. Orthologous to several human genes including CHRAC1 (chromatin accessibility complex subunit 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853384.name: LAS21
853384.summary: Enables mannose-ethanolamine phosphotransferase activity. Involved in GPI anchor biosynthetic process. Located in endoplasmic reticulum membrane and plasma membrane. Orthologous to human PIGG (phosphatidylinositol glycan anchor biosynthesis class G (EMM blood group)). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853387.name: YHC3
853387.summary: Involved in L-arginine transmembrane transport; lysine transport; and regulation of intracellular pH. Located in fungal-type vacuole. Used to study neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis 3. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis 3. Orthologous to human CLN3 (CLN3 lysosomal/endosomal transmembrane protein, battenin). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853408.name: MHP1
853408.summary: A structural constituent of cytoskeleton. Involved in fungal-type cell wall organization and negative regulation of microtubule depolymerization. Located in microtubule. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853422.name: MAD2
853422.summary: Involved in mitotic DNA integrity checkpoint signaling; mitotic spindle assembly checkpoint signaling; and positive regulation of protein autoubiquitination. Located in kinetochore. Part of mitotic checkpoint complex. Orthologous to human MAD2L1 (mitotic arrest deficient 2 like 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853452.name: CYR1
853452.otheraliases: YJL005W, CDC35, FIL1, HSR1, SRA4, TSM0185
853452.summary: Enables adenylate cyclase activity. Involved in Ras protein signal transduction; adenylate cyclase-modulating G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway; and positive regulation of Ras protein signal transduction. Located in endoplasmic reticulum membrane; mitochondrion; and plasma membrane. Orthologous to human PHLPP1 (PH domain and leucine rich repeat protein phosphatase 1) and PHLPP2 (PH domain and leucine rich repeat protein phosphatase 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853453.name: SYS1
853453.summary: Involved in Golgi to endosome transport; Golgi to plasma membrane protein transport; and protein localization to Golgi apparatus. Located in Golgi membrane and trans-Golgi network. Orthologous to human SYS1 (SYS1 golgi trafficking protein). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853457.name: AVT1
853457.summary: Enables L-amino acid transmembrane transporter activity. Involved in L-histidine transmembrane import into vacuole; proline transport; and vacuolar transport. Located in fungal-type vacuole membrane. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in developmental and epileptic encephalopathy and generalized epilepsy with febrile seizures plus. Orthologous to human SLC32A1 (solute carrier family 32 member 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853460.name: SAG1
853460.summary: Enables cell adhesion molecule binding activity. Involved in agglutination involved in conjugation with cellular fusion. Located in fungal-type cell wall. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853465.name: TDH2
853465.summary: Enables glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase (NAD+) (phosphorylating) activity; melatonin binding activity; and promoter-specific chromatin binding activity. Involved in several processes, including gluconeogenesis; glycolytic process; and reactive oxygen species metabolic process. Located in several cellular components, including fungal-type cell wall; lipid droplet; and mitochondrion. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Alzheimer's disease. Orthologous to several human genes including GAPDH (glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853490.name: RAV1
853490.summary: Involved in several processes, including early endosome to late endosome transport; vacuolar acidification; and vacuolar proton-transporting V-type ATPase complex assembly. Located in cytoplasm. Part of RAVE complex. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal dominant nonsyndromic deafness 71 and developmental and epileptic encephalopathy 81. Orthologous to human DMXL1 (Dmx like 1) and DMXL2 (Dmx like 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853503.name: SSC1
853503.summary: Enables several functions, including ATP hydrolysis activity; mitochondrial protein-transporting ATPase activity; and protein translocation chaperone activity. Involved in several processes, including mitochondrial proton-transporting ATP synthase complex assembly; protein import into mitochondrial matrix; and protein refolding. Located in mitochondrial inner membrane and mitochondrial nucleoid. Part of PAM complex, Tim23 associated import motor. Used to study Parkinson's disease. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Parkinson's disease and autosomal dominant sideroblastic anemia 4. Orthologous to human HSPA9 (heat shock protein family A (Hsp70) member 9). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853507.name: CYC1
853507.summary: Enables cardiolipin binding activity and electron transfer activity. Involved in mitochondrial electron transport, cytochrome c to oxygen and mitochondrial electron transport, ubiquinol to cytochrome c. Located in mitochondrial intermembrane space. Used to study hyperglycemia and thrombocytopenia. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in cholangiocarcinoma; lung non-small cell carcinoma; pancreatic cancer; and thrombocytopenia. Orthologous to human CYCS (cytochrome c, somatic). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853522.name: PTK2
853522.summary: Enables protein kinase activity. Involved in G1/S transition of mitotic cell cycle; intracellular monoatomic ion homeostasis; and polyamine transport. Located in cytoplasm; nucleus; and plasma membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853529.name: TOR1
853529.summary: Enables protein serine/threonine kinase activity. Involved in several processes, including gene expression; intracellular signal transduction; and peptidyl-serine phosphorylation. Located in bounding membrane of organelle; nucleus; and plasma membrane. Part of TORC1 complex. Used to study cancer. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease; kidney angiomyolipoma; lung disease (multiple); prostate cancer; and type 2 diabetes mellitus. Orthologous to human MTOR (mechanistic target of rapamycin kinase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853536.name: OPI3
853536.summary: Enables phosphatidyl-N-methylethanolamine N-methyltransferase activity. Involved in phosphatidylcholine biosynthetic process. Located in cell periphery; endoplasmic reticulum; and mitochondrion. Orthologous to human PEMT (phosphatidylethanolamine N-methyltransferase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853540.name: MIR1
853540.summary: Enables phosphate transmembrane transporter activity. Involved in phosphate ion transmembrane transport. Located in mitochondrial inner membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853541.name: BNA2
853541.summary: Enables indoleamine 2,3-dioxygenase activity. Involved in 'de novo' NAD+ biosynthetic process from L-tryptophan. Located in cytoplasm. Orthologous to human IDO1 (indoleamine 2,3-dioxygenase 1) and IDO2 (indoleamine 2,3-dioxygenase 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853543.name: AIM24
853543.summary: Involved in inner mitochondrial membrane organization. Located in mitochondrial inner membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853551.name: BIR1
853551.summary: Predicted to enable zinc ion binding activity. Involved in apoptotic process; mitotic spindle assembly checkpoint signaling; and sister chromatid segregation. Located in several cellular components, including kinetochore; nucleus; and spindle midzone. Part of chromosome passenger complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853557.name: RPL43B
853557.summary: Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Predicted to be involved in cytoplasmic translation. Part of cytosolic large ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to human RPL37A (ribosomal protein L37a) and RPL37AP8 (ribosomal protein L37a pseudogene 8). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853562.name: YUH1
853562.summary: Enables cysteine-type deubiquitinase activity and ubiquitin-like protein-specific endopeptidase activity. Involved in protein maturation. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Alzheimer's disease; Parkinson's disease; hereditary spastic paraplegia 79A; and hereditary spastic paraplegia 79B. Orthologous to several human genes including UCHL1 (ubiquitin C-terminal hydrolase L1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853566.name: VPS25
853566.summary: Enables structural molecule activity. Involved in several processes, including ATP export; double-strand break repair via break-induced replication; and ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process via the multivesicular body sorting pathway. Located in cytosol. Part of ESCRT II complex. Orthologous to human VPS25 (vacuolar protein sorting 25 homolog). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853568.name: SOD1
853568.summary: Enables oxidoreductase activity, acting on a sulfur group of donors, oxygen as acceptor and superoxide dismutase activity. Involved in several processes, including intracellular monoatomic cation homeostasis; protein stabilization; and removal of superoxide radicals. Located in mitochondrial intermembrane space and nucleus. Is active in cytosol. Used to study amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including Down syndrome; artery disease (multiple); eye disease (multiple); glucose metabolism disease (multiple); and neurodegenerative disease (multiple). Orthologous to human SOD1 (superoxide dismutase 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853585.name: ATP2
853585.summary: Enables proton-transporting ATPase activity, rotational mechanism. Contributes to ATP hydrolysis activity and proton-transporting ATP synthase activity, rotational mechanism. Involved in proton motive force-driven ATP synthesis. Located in mitochondrial inner membrane. Part of proton-transporting ATP synthase complex. Orthologous to human ATP5F1B (ATP synthase F1 subunit beta). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853586.name: IBA57
853586.summary: Involved in protein maturation. Located in mitochondrial matrix. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in hereditary spastic paraplegia 74 and multiple mitochondrial dysfunctions syndrome 3. Orthologous to human IBA57 (iron-sulfur cluster assembly factor IBA57). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853590.name: VPS70
853590.summary: Predicted to enable carboxypeptidase activity. Involved in protein targeting to vacuole. Located in endoplasmic reticulum. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including abdominal aortic aneurysm; cerebral infarction; hemochromatosis (multiple); immunodeficiency 46; and multiple myeloma. Orthologous to several human genes including NAALAD2 (N-acetylated alpha-linked acidic dipeptidase 2) and FOLH1 (folate hydrolase 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853592.name: RSF2
853592.summary: Enables sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Involved in regulation of DNA-templated transcription. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853595.name: MNS1
853595.summary: Enables calcium ion binding activity and mannosyl-oligosaccharide 1,2-alpha-mannosidase activity. Involved in ERAD pathway and protein deglycosylation involved in glycoprotein catabolic process. Located in endoplasmic reticulum. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Rafiq syndrome. Orthologous to human MAN1B1 (mannosidase alpha class 1B member 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853602.name: MET5
853602.summary: Contributes to sulfite reductase (NADPH) activity. Involved in sulfate assimilation and sulfur amino acid biosynthetic process. Located in cell periphery; cytoplasmic stress granule; and fungal-type vacuole. Part of sulfite reductase complex (NADPH). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853605.name: HIR3
853605.summary: Enables transcription corepressor activity. Contributes to DNA binding activity and nucleosome binding activity. Involved in several processes, including G1/S transition of mitotic cell cycle; nucleosome assembly; and transcription elongation by RNA polymerase II. Located in nucleus. Part of HIR complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853610.name: RPS4A
853610.summary: A structural constituent of ribosome. Predicted to be involved in translation. Located in cytoplasm. Part of cytosolic small ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to human RPS4X (ribosomal protein S4 X-linked); RPS4Y1 (ribosomal protein S4 Y-linked 1); and RPS4Y2 (ribosomal protein S4 Y-linked 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853629.name: ADD66
853629.summary: Predicted to enable molecular adaptor activity. Involved in proteasome core complex assembly. Located in cytosol. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in proteosome-associated autoinflammatory syndrome 4. Orthologous to human PSMG2 (proteasome assembly chaperone 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853630.name: LOS1
853630.summary: Enables small GTPase binding activity. Involved in tRNA re-export from nucleus. Located in cytoplasm and nuclear matrix. Orthologous to human XPOT (exportin for tRNA). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853668.name: SAC1
853668.summary: Enables phosphatidylinositol-3,5-bisphosphate 3-phosphatase activity; phosphatidylinositol-3-phosphate phosphatase activity; and phosphatidylinositol-4-phosphate phosphatase activity. Involved in phosphatidylinositol dephosphorylation. Acts upstream of or within autophagosome-lysosome fusion. Located in Golgi apparatus; endoplasmic reticulum subcompartment; and host cell viral assembly compartment. Part of serine palmitoyltransferase complex. Orthologous to human SACM1L (SAC1 like phosphatidylinositide phosphatase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853683.name: NNK1
853683.summary: Enables protein kinase activity. Involved in proteolysis. Located in cytoplasm. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853684.name: MRPL38
853684.summary: A structural constituent of ribosome. Predicted to be involved in mitochondrial translation. Located in mitochondrion. Part of mitochondrial large ribosomal subunit. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853688.name: TPK3
853688.description: cAMP-dependent protein kinase catalytic subunit TPK3
853688.otherdesignations: cAMP-dependent protein kinase catalytic subunit TPK3
853688.nomenclaturename: cAMP-dependent protein kinase catalytic subunit TPK3
853688.summary: Enables cAMP-dependent protein kinase activity. Involved in several processes, including Ras protein signal transduction; negative regulation of cytoplasmic mRNA processing body assembly; and negative regulation of cytoplasmic translation. Located in P-body; cytoplasmic stress granule; and nucleus. Part of cAMP-dependent protein kinase complex. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in adrenal cortical adenoma; congestive heart failure; fibrolamellar carcinoma; platelet-type bleeding disorder 19; and primary pigmented nodular adrenocortical disease 4. Orthologous to several human genes including PRKACA (protein kinase cAMP-activated catalytic subunit alpha); PRKACB (protein kinase cAMP-activated catalytic subunit beta); and PRKACG (protein kinase cAMP-activated catalytic subunit gamma). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853700.name: RPS27A
853700.summary: A structural constituent of ribosome. Involved in maturation of SSU-rRNA from tricistronic rRNA transcript (SSU-rRNA, 5.8S rRNA, LSU-rRNA) and ribosomal small subunit assembly. Located in cytoplasm. Part of cytosolic small ribosomal subunit. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Diamond-Blackfan anemia 17. Orthologous to human RPS27 (ribosomal protein S27) and RPS27L (ribosomal protein S27 like). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853709.name: SDH1
853709.summary: Enables flavin adenine dinucleotide binding activity and succinate dehydrogenase (quinone) activity. Involved in mitochondrial electron transport, succinate to ubiquinone and tricarboxylic acid cycle. Located in mitochondrial inner membrane. Part of respiratory chain complex II (succinate dehydrogenase). Used to study several diseases, including Leigh disease; endocrine organ benign neoplasm (multiple); gastrointestinal stromal tumor; leukodystrophy; and mitochondrial complex II deficiency. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Leigh disease; dilated cardiomyopathy 1GG; lung non-small cell carcinoma; mitochondrial complex II deficiency; and pheochromocytoma/paraganglioma syndrome 5. Orthologous to human SDHA (succinate dehydrogenase complex flavoprotein subunit A). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853712.name: RPT1
853712.description: proteasome regulatory particle base subunit RPT1
853712.otherdesignations: proteasome regulatory particle base subunit RPT1
853712.nomenclaturename: proteasome regulatory particle base subunit RPT1
853712.summary: Enables ubiquitin protein ligase binding activity. Involved in several processes, including positive regulation of RNA polymerase II transcription preinitiation complex assembly; positive regulation of protein catabolic process; and proteasome regulatory particle assembly. Part of proteasome regulatory particle, base subcomplex. Used to study cancer. Orthologous to human PSMC2 (proteasome 26S subunit, ATPase 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853718.name: CTK1
853718.summary: Enables cyclin-dependent protein serine/threonine kinase activity. Involved in gene expression; positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription; and positive regulation of translational fidelity. Located in nucleolus and nucleoplasm. Part of CTDK-1 complex. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in congenital heart defects, dysmorphic facial features, and intellectual developmental disorder; hepatocellular carcinoma; intellectual disability; and prostate carcinoma. Orthologous to several human genes including CDK13 (cyclin dependent kinase 13). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853723.name: APL2
853723.summary: Enables clathrin binding activity. Involved in Golgi to vacuole transport and vesicle targeting, trans-Golgi to endosome. Located in cytosol. Part of AP-1 adaptor complex. Orthologous to human AP1B1 (adaptor related protein complex 1 subunit beta 1) and AP2B1 (adaptor related protein complex 2 subunit beta 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853733.name: YPK1
853733.summary: Enables protein kinase regulator activity and protein serine/threonine kinase activity. Involved in several processes, including cellular response to acetate; eisosome assembly; and regulation of fungal-type cell wall organization. Located in cellular bud neck; cytosol; and plasma membrane. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in hypertension. Orthologous to several human genes including C8orf44-SGK3 (C8orf44-SGK3 readthrough); SGK1 (serum/glucocorticoid regulated kinase 1); and SGK2 (serum/glucocorticoid regulated kinase 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853738.name: DGR2
853738.summary: Orthologous to human WDR44 (WD repeat domain 44). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853747.name: RAD27
853747.summary: Enables 5'-3' exonuclease activity and 5'-flap endonuclease activity. Involved in DNA metabolic process. Located in cytosol and mitochondrion. Is active in nucleus. Used to study cancer. Orthologous to human FEN1 (flap structure-specific endonuclease 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853751.name: HAP4
853751.summary: Enables RNA polymerase II-specific DNA-binding transcription factor binding activity and transcription coactivator activity. Involved in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and regulation of cellular respiration. Part of CCAAT-binding activity factor complex and respiratory chain complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853755.name: AAT1
853755.summary: Predicted to enable L-aspartate:2-oxoglutarate transaminase activity. Involved in alpha-amino acid metabolic process. Is active in mitochondrion. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in developmental and epileptic encephalopathy 82. Orthologous to human GOT2 (glutamic-oxaloacetic transaminase 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853756.name: SEG2
853756.summary: Located in cell periphery. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853775.name: CYT2
853775.summary: Enables holocytochrome-c synthase activity. Involved in cytochrome c-heme linkage. Located in mitochondrial intermembrane space. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853777.name: MDH1
853777.summary: Enables L-malate dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity and mRNA binding activity. Involved in tricarboxylic acid cycle. Located in mitochondrial matrix. Used to study developmental and epileptic encephalopathy 51. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in developmental and epileptic encephalopathy 51. Orthologous to human MDH2 (malate dehydrogenase 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853789.name: LHS1
853789.summary: Enables ATP binding activity; adenyl-nucleotide exchange factor activity; and unfolded protein binding activity. Involved in post-translational protein targeting to membrane, translocation and response to unfolded protein. Located in endoplasmic reticulum lumen. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in immunodeficiency 59. Orthologous to human HYOU1 (hypoxia up-regulated 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853794.name: YKL069W
853794.summary: Enables L-methionine (R)-S-oxide reductase activity. Involved in cellular response to oxidative stress. Located in cytosol and nucleus. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853809.name: TMA19
853809.summary: Predicted to enable calcium ion binding activity. Involved in cytoplasmic translation; negative regulation of autophagy; and negative regulation of microtubule depolymerization. Located in cytosol and mitochondrion. Orthologous to several human genes including TPT1 (tumor protein, translationally-controlled 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853820.name: DCW1
853820.summary: Predicted to enable mannan endo-1,6-alpha-mannosidase activity. Involved in budding cell bud growth and fungal-type cell wall biogenesis. Located in plasma membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853823.name: PHD1
853823.summary: Enables DNA-binding transcription factor activity. Involved in positive regulation of pseudohyphal growth and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Located in nucleus. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853825.name: VPS24
853825.summary: Enables identical protein binding activity. Involved in several processes, including ATP export; intralumenal vesicle formation; and ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process via the multivesicular body sorting pathway. Located in cytoplasm. Part of ESCRT III complex. Orthologous to human RNF103-CHMP3 (RNF103-CHMP3 readthrough) and CHMP3 (charged multivesicular body protein 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853826.name: NFU1
853826.summary: Predicted to enable 4 iron, 4 sulfur cluster binding activity. Involved in [4Fe-4S] cluster assembly. Located in mitochondrial matrix. Used to study multiple mitochondrial dysfunctions syndrome 1. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in hereditary spastic paraplegia 93 and multiple mitochondrial dysfunctions syndrome 1. Orthologous to human NFU1 (NFU1 iron-sulfur cluster scaffold). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853828.name: RGT1
853828.summary: Enables DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific; DNA-binding transcription repressor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific; and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Involved in glucose metabolic process; negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II; and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Located in nucleus. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853845.name: SKA1
853845.summary: Involved in nuclear-transcribed mRNA catabolic process. Located in cytoplasm. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853860.name: MRT4
853860.summary: Predicted to enable large ribosomal subunit rRNA binding activity. Involved in nuclear-transcribed mRNA catabolic process and ribosome biogenesis. Located in nucleolus and nucleoplasm. Part of preribosome, large subunit precursor. Orthologous to human MRTO4 (MRT4 homolog, ribosome maturation factor). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853869.name: MET14
853869.summary: Enables adenylylsulfate kinase activity. Involved in sulfate assimilation, phosphoadenylyl sulfate reduction by phosphoadenylyl-sulfate reductase (thioredoxin) and sulfur amino acid metabolic process. Located in cytoplasm. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in spondyloepimetaphyseal dysplasia, Pakistani type. Orthologous to human PAPSS1 (3'-phosphoadenosine 5'-phosphosulfate synthase 1) and PAPSS2 (3'-phosphoadenosine 5'-phosphosulfate synthase 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853872.name: OSH6
853872.summary: Enables lipid transfer activity; phosphatidylinositol-3,4-bisphosphate binding activity; and phospholipid binding activity. Involved in several processes, including intermembrane phospholipid transfer; piecemeal microautophagy of the nucleus; and sterol homeostasis. Located in cortical endoplasmic reticulum. Is active in endoplasmic reticulum-plasma membrane contact site. Orthologous to human OSBPL5 (oxysterol binding protein like 5) and OSBPL8 (oxysterol binding protein like 8). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853878.name: FOX2
853878.summary: Enables (3S)-3-hydroxyacyl-CoA dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity and enoyl-CoA hydratase activity. Involved in fatty acid beta-oxidation. Located in peroxisome. Used to study lipid metabolism disorder. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in D-bifunctional protein deficiency; Perrault syndrome; and Stiff-Person syndrome. Orthologous to human HSD17B4 (hydroxysteroid 17-beta dehydrogenase 4). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853900.name: SET3
853900.summary: Enables histone H3K4me3 reader activity and histone H3K9me2/3 reader activity. Involved in negative regulation of meiotic nuclear division and regulation of DNA-templated transcription. Acts upstream of or within transcription initiation-coupled chromatin remodeling. Located in nucleus. Part of Set3 complex. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal dominant intellectual developmental disorder 23. Orthologous to human SETD5 (SET domain containing 5). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853906.name: DID2
853906.summary: Involved in ESCRT III complex assembly; late endosome to vacuole transport via multivesicular body sorting pathway; and protein targeting to vacuole. Located in late endosome. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in pontocerebellar hypoplasia type 8. Orthologous to several human genes including CHMP1B (charged multivesicular body protein 1B). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853916.name: UTH1
853916.summary: Involved in autophagy of mitochondrion and fungal-type cell wall biogenesis. Located in mitochondrial inner membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853923.name: FMP46
853923.summary: Predicted to enable oxidoreductase activity. Involved in negative regulation of transport. Located in mitochondrion. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853926.name: MRS4
853926.summary: Enables ferrous iron transmembrane transporter activity. Involved in iron import into the mitochondrion. Located in mitochondrial inner membrane. Orthologous to human SLC25A28 (solute carrier family 25 member 28) and SLC25A37 (solute carrier family 25 member 37). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853933.name: TIF1
853933.summary: Enables RNA helicase activity and translation initiation factor activity. Involved in positive regulation of formation of translation preinitiation complex and translational initiation. Located in cytoplasmic stress granule and plasma membrane. Part of eukaryotic translation initiation factor 4F complex. Is active in cytoplasm. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in neurodevelopmental disorder with hypotonia and speech delay. Orthologous to human EIF4A1 (eukaryotic translation initiation factor 4A1) and EIF4A2 (eukaryotic translation initiation factor 4A2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853941.name: GPT2
853941.summary: Enables glycerol-3-phosphate O-acyltransferase activity and glycerone-phosphate O-acyltransferase activity. Involved in phospholipid biosynthetic process and regulation of triglyceride metabolic process. Located in endoplasmic reticulum and lipid droplet. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853946.name: SIS2
853946.summary: Enables identical protein binding activity and protein serine/threonine phosphatase inhibitor activity. Contributes to phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylase activity. Involved in coenzyme A biosynthetic process; regulation of mitotic cell cycle; and response to salt stress. Located in chromatin and nucleus. Part of CoA-synthesizing protein complex and phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylase complex. Used to study dilated cardiomyopathy. Orthologous to human PPCDC (phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853955.name: MTD1
853955.summary: Enables methylenetetrahydrofolate dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity. Involved in folic acid-containing compound biosynthetic process; one-carbon metabolic process; and purine nucleobase biosynthetic process. Located in cytosol. Orthologous to human MTHFD2L (methylenetetrahydrofolate dehydrogenase (NADP+ dependent) 2 like) and MTHFD2 (methylenetetrahydrofolate dehydrogenase (NADP+ dependent) 2, methenyltetrahydrofolate cyclohydrolase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853960.name: MRPL20
853960.summary: A structural constituent of ribosome. Predicted to be involved in mitochondrial translation. Located in mitochondrion. Part of mitochondrial large ribosomal subunit. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853962.name: OMA1
853962.summary: Enables metalloendopeptidase activity. Involved in TOR signaling; mitochondrial protein quality control; and mitochondrion organization. Located in mitochondrial inner membrane. Orthologous to human OMA1 (OMA1 zinc metallopeptidase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853965.name: PXL1
853965.summary: Enables Rho GDP-dissociation inhibitor activity. Involved in maintenance of cell polarity and regulation of Rho protein signal transduction. Located in several cellular components, including cellular bud tip; incipient cellular bud site; and mating projection tip. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in combined pituitary hormone deficiency 4. Orthologous to human LHX4 (LIM homeobox 4) and LHX8 (LIM homeobox 8). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853971.name: ESL2
853971.summary: Predicted to enable telomerase RNA binding activity and telomeric repeat DNA binding activity. Predicted to be involved in nuclear-transcribed mRNA catabolic process, nonsense-mediated decay. Located in peroxisome. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

853972.name: PCK1
853972.summary: Enables phosphoenolpyruvate carboxykinase (ATP) activity. Involved in gluconeogenesis. Located in cytosol. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853974.name: BAS1
853974.summary: Enables DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Involved in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Located in nucleus. Orthologous to several human genes including MYB (MYB proto-oncogene, transcription factor). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853980.name: VBA5
853980.summary: Predicted to enable transmembrane transporter activity. Involved in L-arginine transmembrane transport. Located in plasma membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

853994.name: MDH2
853994.summary: Enables L-malate dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity. Involved in gluconeogenesis and protein import into peroxisome matrix. Located in cytosol and nuclear periphery. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in developmental and epileptic encephalopathy 51. Orthologous to human MDH2 (malate dehydrogenase 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854036.name: SKM1
854036.summary: Enables protein kinase activity. Involved in several processes, including negative regulation of sterol import; regulation of gene expression; and sterol import. Located in nucleus and plasma membrane. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in breast cancer; ductal carcinoma in situ; non-syndromic X-linked intellectual disability 30; renal cell carcinoma; and schizophrenia. Orthologous to human PAK1 (p21 (RAC1) activated kinase 1); PAK2 (p21 (RAC1) activated kinase 2); and PAK3 (p21 (RAC1) activated kinase 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

854042.name: INO4
854042.summary: Contributes to DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Involved in phospholipid biosynthetic process and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Located in nucleus. Part of RNA polymerase II transcription regulator complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

854053.name: PKH2
854053.summary: Enables protein serine/threonine kinase activity. Involved in several processes, including cell integrity MAPK cascade; late endosome to vacuole transport via multivesicular body sorting pathway; and positive regulation of cytoplasmic mRNA processing body assembly. Located in cell cortex and nucleus. Is active in eisosome. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in prostate cancer. Orthologous to human PDPK1 (3-phosphoinositide dependent protein kinase 1) and PDPK2P (3-phosphoinositide dependent protein kinase 2, pseudogene). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]
